body:
## Context

Phase 6B requires a `finance_eod_gap` alert emitter (see `src/coach/coach-alerts.service.ts` — the alert type is already in the enum).

Per the brief, this emitter should fire from the inbound federation endpoint `POST /admin/federation/ptm-signal` (Agent 1A's work, branch `fix/ptm-app-open-and-finance-federation`).

## Trigger condition

When **5+ consecutive `finance_eod_skip`-like signals** arrive within a **7-day window** for the same client, emit a `finance_eod_gap` alert to that client's coach.

## Dependency

Agent 1A is wiring `POST /admin/federation/ptm-signal` which accepts inbound finance signals. Once that endpoint exists, the emitter hook should be added inside `federation-inbound.service.ts` (or equivalent), calling:

```ts
await this.coachAlerts.createAlert({
  coachId: client.coach_id,
  clientId: client.id,
  alertType: 'finance_eod_gap',
  severity: 'warning',
  message: `Client has not received finance EOD signal for ${gapDays} days`,
  payload: { consecutive_finance_eod_skip_count: count, window_days: 7 },
});
```

The 24-hour dedup in `CoachAlertsService.createAlert` will prevent notification storms automatically.

## Files to touch when unblocked

- `src/admin/federation/federation-inbound.service.ts` — add finance EOD gap detection logic after the `finance_eod_skip` signal is processed
- `test/coach-alerts-emitters.spec.ts` — add the `finance_eod_gap` test case (TODO stubs already exist)
- `docs/coach-signals.md` — update emitter status from `reserved` to `live`

## Current state (as of PR feat/coach-alerts-push-and-emitters)

The `finance_eod_gap` alert type is enumerated in `CoachAlertType` but has no active emitter. The other three alert types (`risk_red_transition`, `consecutive_misses`, `streak_dropped`) are now live.

Blocked on: `fix/ptm-app-open-and-finance-federation` (Agent 1A)
title: feat(coach-alerts): wire finance_eod_gap emitter once Agent 1A federation endpoint lands
